issues.description: `decideChatRoute()` in `routing/router.ts` can still return `farm_query`, and `resolveRouteClarificationResponse('2')` still resolves to `farm_query`, but the live dispatch block in `handleRequest()` only handles `clarify_route` and `voice_log` before falling through to the advisory path. `handlers/farm-query.ts:30` exists, but `handleFarmQuery()` is never imported or called anywhere in the runtime path, so deterministic farm-query handling is still unreachable.

The legacy `voice-routing.ts` monolith still exists in the current tree at 1364 lines, while `routing/router.ts` is another 1406-line copy of the same routing/voice-log logic. The live request path also still inlines clarify/voice-log handling in `handlers/main.ts:225-273` instead of dispatching through `handlers/clarify.ts` and `handlers/voice-log.ts`, so the required removal of legacy duplicated routing/handler logic is still not complete.

The live voice-log branch still increments `voice_log_clarify_attempts` on clarify, but on cancel/ready it only clears `voice_log_draft`. It never resets `voice_log_expected_field` or `voice_log_clarify_attempts`, even though `handlers/voice-log.ts:66` already computes the correct next-state values. A later logging flow can therefore inherit stale clarification state and exhaust too early.
